question: Can a colour-independent content-cell worst-case validation gate reject a reference whose pooled appearance is byte-identical to a valid reference but whose content-cell correspondence is shuffled?

content_cells.identity_source: generated latent scene identity exposed only to the evaluator, never inferred from RGB

optimization.device_reason: frozen local smoke measured 10 steps at 2.91s CPU versus 6.71s CUDA for this small RK4 workload

policy.selection: hard select one candidate by pooled validation mean normalized residual; authorize only when every frozen content cell passes

allowed_actions: reuse the BK21 two-objective O0 fitting path without adding capacity
fit one candidate per canonicalizer on pooled generated fit cells
evaluate pooled and per-cell validation losses on independent samples
use external generated cell identity only for this mechanism test
hard-select one explicit operator or return exact identity
forbidden_actions: infer content cells from RGB, histograms, CLIP, uploader, geometry or scanner
fit a separate operator per content cell
change the cell permutation, threshold, losses or capacity after formal output
use current film pixels, claim operator identification or promote a product
claim_ceiling: synthetic mechanism evidence that externally supplied colour-independent content cells can or cannot veto a pooled appearance shortcut; no real content labels, film operator, stock, mode, calibration, preference or product claim
